name: Oozing Sap
body:
Your wounds ooze sap and close quickly.

Prerequisites: Plant type

Benefit: Whenever you take bleed damage, on the following round you negate 1 cumulative point of bleed per round.

Dwellers in Dream: The Briarborn. Copyright, January 27, 2013, Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian “Necroblivion” Berg, Richard “AWizardInDallas” Hunt
